entities.name: PMID:10735601
observations: In recurrent aborters receiving husband-derived PBMC/lymphocyte immunotherapy, the report described prevention of recurrent abortion/subsequent pregnancy benefit, but the abstract did not provide numerical efficacy estimates or a comparator.
CD158a, CD158b, CD159, and CD94 expression and the KAR:KIR balance showed no apparent pre/post-treatment change; the authors inferred benefit through mechanisms unrelated to NK-receptor status.

entities.name: PMID:38045499
observations: Lymphocyte immunotherapy altered NK-cell population measurements, including a decrease in CD56dim NK-cell percentage, but this study did not establish changes in KIR/NK-receptor expression or genotype and did not establish live-birth efficacy.

entities.name: PMID:36835892
observations: Review of KIR genes, NK abnormalities, activated T cells, and cytokines in recurrent abortion; it is not a direct pre/post-immunotherapy receptor study.
